source_review.grade: Source-only; reviewer ran no tests or live validation
source_review.boundary: Matching GET consumer is in sibling daemon source; composed-binary integration remains PM-owned and unverified here.

motivation: PM reports local07 measured cursor2,45 but no later typing API snapshot. Terminal appearance alone cannot distinguish transient readiness from persistent unrecognition.

implementation.captureSmokeFinalTyping: Rereads /v1/seats, filters native-attested Copilot seats to actual panes on the private socket, and GETs /v1/inbox/typing with each current seat/native_session/pid/proc_start tuple. Retains the unmodified response or named PIJ_NATIVE_FINAL_TYPING error and measured pane_capture.
implementation.callback_lifetime: Installed after the owned daemon is ready and API/roster functions exist. Reads the current key and fresh roster at invocation, not saved launch tuples.
implementation.failure_exit_path: finishSmokePanes awaits final_typing_capture and legacy final pane captures before kill-server. runSmoke awaits this before stopOwned(daemon).
implementation.success_mode_path: Each mode appends a manual-final-typing-capture or spawned-final-typing-capture witness before the existing per-mode kill-pane loop; otherwise successful panes would already be gone by outer finally.
implementation.bounds: Shared 5000ms AbortSignal for roster and typing HTTP requests, passed through to actual fetch. Existing synchronous tmux commands each retain their 15000ms deadline; 5000ms is not a whole-finalization wall-clock claim.
implementation.measurement: Batch started_at_ms/completed_at_ms; each seat/request and requested_at_ms/completed_at_ms plus pane_capture timestamp/cursor/dimensions/raw unjoined viewport. timing=nearby-not-atomic; viewport is later than its API read, never represented as the daemon's exact sensor frame.
implementation.failures: Per-seat API and pane errors are independent. Missing key/daemon/roster becomes named batch error when initialized; uninitialized callback gets final_typing_capture_skipped=daemon-api-roster-not-initialized. Unexpected callback error retained separately. Diagnostic failures never rewrite status/error/code; existing cleanup failure behavior remains strict.
